# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

replicate 3 3 3

pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep 0.001  # 1 fs

# Compute temperature
compute mytemp all temp

# Thermodynamic output settings

fix npt_heat all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run 1000000
unfix npt_heat

# Equilibrate at 2500K for 500 ps (500,000 steps)

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data

    file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

Or from linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t, so D = slope / 6

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD (column 5)

boundary        p p p

replicate       3 3 3

neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

compute msd_compute all msd com yes

timestep 0.001  # 1 fs

thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (Angstroms, eV, ps, etc.)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute for MSD (will be used during equilibration)
compute         msd_compute all msd com yes

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Initial velocities at 300K
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# ===== HEATING PHASE: 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps =====

unfix           heat_npt

# ===== EQUILIBRATION PHASE: 2500K for 500 ps =====
